items.title: Ray Bauduc Interview, 1984-06-26
items.q: Bouchon came with the band... That's when Bouchon joined the band

ctx.x: And that's, that, that, that's the, that's where we came back and we played that. That's where Nappy and, and, and Bouchon came with the band, see. And then Lefty Ironman came with the band.
